node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock for copper SX-EW and nickel HPAL
summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint. The most direct public-market exposures found in this pass are not pure copper or nickel producers, but chemical distributors, sulphuric-acid logistics/merchant-acid platforms, phosphate producers with large acid/sulphur requirements, and copper miners whose SX-EW output depends on acid availability. The underfollowed lane remains evidence-light and needs verification of contract exposure, regional storage, net seller versus net buyer status, and whether acid tightness improves margins or creates cost pressure.
